Major AI Developments.title: Haryana real estate body orders Rs 4-crore payout for Chintels Paradiso flat buyer, using Google AI
Major AI Developments.summary: The Haryana real estate body has ordered a payout of Rs 4 crore to a buyer of a Chintels Paradiso flat. This decision was made with the assistance of Google AI technology. The payout is a significant development in the case, highlighting the use of AI in real estate dispute resolution.

Major AI Developments.title: ’13 bombs’ threat: Punjab and Haryana High Court targeted in AI-generated threat mail
Major AI Developments.summary: The Punjab and Haryana High Court received a threat email claiming 13 bombs had been planted in the building. The email was generated using artificial intelligence, according to reports. Authorities are investigating the threat, which has raised security concerns at the court.
